# arin_irr_aut_nums (Data Source)

List IRR aut-num references maintained by an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_irr_aut_nums" "example" {
  org_handle = "FT-684"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_handle` (String) ARIN organization handle.

### Read-Only

- `aut_nums` (Attributes List) Records returned by ARIN, ordered deterministically. An empty collection is an empty list; authorization and missing-object errors remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aut_nums))

<a id="nestedatt--aut_nums"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aut_nums`

Read-Only:

- `as_number` (String) as number returned by ARIN.
- `entry_type` (String) entry type returned by ARIN.
